comments.text:
Hello! 👋

We are launching a new Azerbaijani-language travel media project called BEYOND AZ and would love to explore a possible collaboration with your channel.

We are interested in discussing permission to use selected footage from your travel videos to create original Azerbaijani-language productions with our own narration, editing and storytelling, with full credit and direct links to your channel.

Could you please share the best email address or contact method where I can send you the full collaboration proposal and details?

Thank you! 🙏
